text:
Noah: Quick heads-up — after the quantization sweep on rdx-llama-13b-q4 we see a regression on the golden summarization promptset. 7/120 examples fail style/conciseness SLOs. Need a quick labeler handoff + sampling fix. :eyes:
Lina: Can you paste the failing ids and the diff vs fp16? curious if it's hallucination or verbosity.
curation-bot: [auto-alert] golden-regression detected | model=rdx-llama-13b-q4 | metric=style_score_drop | delta=-0.18 | affected=7/120 | sample_ids=[g123,g128,g210,g312,g399,g402,g578]
Sam: Noted — dedupe may be leaking. I saw some near-duplicates between g128 and g128_dup in the pool. I'll run a quick fuzzy-dedupe.
Jess: Also possible sampling bias: quant model was tested with longer-temp sampling config. Maybe shorter generation would match golden. Recommend adding a control-run with temp=0.2, max_tokens=80.
Omar: ops — we shouldn't change production generator params mid-sweep. Use a separate eval job. I'll spin up an isolated run if you give me the config.
Mia: labeler lead — we can take a relabel batch today. Need a filter for the UI to only show the 7 ids plus 100 neighboring examples for context.
Noah: filter for labeler UI: ```id IN ('g123','g128','g210','g312','g399','g402','g578') OR similarity_score > 0.92 AND cohort='summaries'```
Mia: perfect. ETA two hours to prep instruction doc. Will highlight 'verbosity vs completeness' rubric.
Lina: Also add an explicit 'prefer brevity unless content lost' anchor examples pls.
Sam: Running fuzzy dedupe now: results show g128 ~ g129 similarity 0.95 — will mark as dupCandidate.
Jess: I'll run the temp=0.2 control and post metrics here when done.
Omar: spun up eval job 1945-eval-22, queued. ETA ~12m.
curation-bot: job 1945-eval-22 finished | model=rdx-llama-13b-q4 | temp=0.2 | style_drop=-0.03 | affected=2/120
Noah: nice — that suggests sampling. Good news. We'll proceed with labeler rerun on the 7 flagged IDs + dedupe pass.
Mia: got it. creating batch: 107 items (7 flagged + 100 neighbors). assign @labelers-team. Instruction doc link: https://redwood.internal/curation/golden/1945002222
Lina: linking the control run diff: https://storage.redwood/models/rdx-llama-13b-q4/evals/1945-ctrl-diff.txt
Sam: dedupe PR open: https://git.redwood/ops/dedupe/pull/88 — includes fuzzy threshold 0.93.
Noah: thanks. Let's reconvene after labeler completes. If labeler majority flips, we can patch the quant profile or lock sampling for production.
Mia: will ping when batch hits 50% complete. :thumbsup:
